source: Replay of stored Jev responses; no new provider calls

errors.message: A feature map describes current behavior for the next verification pass, not fix history or older checkouts. Once a fix is established, document its behavior directly. Do not retain superseded behavior, before/after narratives, fix chronology, or verification diaries in the map. Keep it clean and concise. An unresolved known defect, its reproduction and issue reference are allowed. Current prerequisites, supported backend/version differences, source references and executable baseline/fix proof commands are allowed; a PR number alone is not a violation.
errors.alternative: State the current expected behavior directly. Remove fix chronology, old-checkout alternatives and dated verification narration. Keep current prerequisites, actionable recipes and unresolved known defects. Preserve historical evidence in the PR/report or Git history instead.
